paragraphs.text: Native side conversations for DeepSeek Harness: fork the active conversation into a sidebar session
with live context, relay, and usage stats.
# Side Conversation

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that opens a native side conversation next to the
current conversation.

> **Community plugin.** This package is not an official DeepSeek plugin and is
> not affiliated with
DeepSeek. Official bundles ship with the Harness.

The side conversation is a real forked session: it inherits the parent's
completed history, runs wit

h the normal conversation UI and tools, and receives
a live snapshot of the parent on every request.

It can relay a request or
conclusion back to the parent, and it reports its own token and cache usa

can relay a request or
conclusion back to the parent, and it reports its own token and cache usage.

It is deliberately a **Live Side Branch**, not a second subagent catalog. The
official DSH `subagent

chat` Sidebar is the place to browse and continue real
subagent children; this plugin is for a human

side branch that needs live parent
context and relay.
## Features

- **Native conversation surface** — the side chat uses the host's own chat view,
composer, model sel

ector, reasoning effort, permission picker, attachments,
commands, and stop controls.
- **Forked bas

eline** — one side session per parent conversation and completed
turn boundary. Reopening before the

parent advances resumes the same side
session; after the parent completes a new turn, a fresh fork

is created from
the new boundary.
- **Live parent context with Inline & Spill** — every request incl

udes the
parent's current state plus a compact reference index (message/tool IDs, short
snippets, in

-flight refs). Long bodies stay out of the window until the model
asks for one exact ref.
- **Chain

recall** — `recall_main_conversation({kind, id})` expands one parent
message or tool call and return

s the next-hop refs, so a long parent history
is walked on demand instead of being dumped into every

request.
- **Conversation boundary** — inherited history is reference material. The side
agent is i

nstructed not to continue the parent task or mutate the workspace
unless explicitly asked.
- **Tool

guard** — subagent, teammate, goal, workflow, and loop tools stay in the
tool schema but are rejecte

d inside a side conversation.
- **Relay** — the side agent can deliver a user-requested message to t

he parent
conversation through the `send_to_main_conversation` tool.
- **Usage stats** — a badge sho

ws the last request and cumulative token/cache
usage; the `read_main_conversation` tool lets the age

nt request a larger
parent snapshot.
- **History** — the History control in the side chat lists earl

ier side
conversations for the parent conversation and reopens them in their own tab.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.1` or newer on the `0.2.1` line (`engines.dsh`);
the current build is t

ested against `0.2.1-rc.5`.
- Node.js 22.19 or newer.
## Installation

In DSH Desktop, open **Settings → Plugins**, search for `dsh-side-conversation`,
and install it. The

plugin manager links or installs the bundle into the active
profile. The npm package is published a

s
`dsh-side-conversation`.

Reload the Web UI after installation if the plugin list does not refresh itself.

If the package is not on npm yet, install from the repository or the release
tarball:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Usage

1. Open a conversation and click the side-conversation button in the header
utilities.
2. Ask questi

ons about the parent conversation, request analysis, or have a
separate discussion.
3. To send a res

ult back, ask the side agent to send it to the parent
conversation; it uses the relay tool.
4. The b

adge in the top-right corner of the side panel shows the last request's
input tokens and cache hit r

in the top-right corner of the side panel shows the last request's
input tokens and cache hit rate.
## How It Works
The host half watches the parent conversation and the side agents:

- `POST /dsh-side-conversation/open` creates or resumes a side session for the
parent's latest compl

eted turn boundary.
- `GET /dsh-side-conversation/stats` returns token, cache, and context usage for

a live side session.
- `GET /dsh-side-conversation/history` lists earlier side sessions for a paren

t
conversation.
- `GET /dsh-side-conversation/health` reports the host and client build.

The side session is an ordinary session with its own agent, so it does not
append subagent notices t

o the parent. Parent state is injected through a
dynamic runtime context; the boundary and instructi

ons are registered as
per-agent prompt sections.
## Compatibility

The plugin targets the `0.2.1` release line and is tested against
`0.2.1-rc.5`. It uses only public

Harness extension points (Web routes, agent
tools, prompt sections, session API, and client slots).
## Privacy

The plugin makes no network requests of its own. Model requests go through the
Harness's configured

provider, and the side session transcript includes context
inherited from the parent conversation. F

iles in the parent conversation are
not copied; the side agent can read them through normal tools wh

e parent conversation are
not copied; the side agent can read them through normal tools when needed.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`npm run check` runs `node --check` on both halves plus the package metadata
validator in `scripts/v

alidate.mjs`. The published package contains the host
half, the client half, the bundle patch, local

e metadata, and the icon. There is
no build step.
## Contributing

Issues and pull requests are welcome. See CONTRIBUTING.md for
the local checks and commit convention

s. The release process is documented in
PUBLISHING.md.
## Security

Report vulnerabilities privately through GitHub security advisories. See
SECURITY.md.
## Changelog
See CHANGELOG.md.
